title: Oct 3 Results + Oct 4 Preview: Three for Four Ain't Bad
summary: We went 3-1 on Oct 3 with a 75% hit rate. Milwaukee's back in tomorrow's spotlight.

content.value:
## Another Solid Day at the Office

You know, I've been doing this long enough to know that 3-1 days are what keep you in business. We hit on three of four yesterday, posting a clean 75% accuracy rate. The Guardians gave us our only hiccup, but when you're right on the Dodgers, Rays, and Brewers, you sleep just fine.

## How the Day Unfolded

The Sox-Guardians game was our only miss, and honestly, a 52% confidence pick is basically a coin flip with a slight lean. No shame there. But the Dodgers at 65%? That's the kind of call that reminds you why we trust the numbers. The Rays and Brewers both came through as predicted, giving us a nice cushion for the day.

## Looking Ahead to October 4

Here's where it gets interesting. We're going back to the well with Milwaukee. The Brewers delivered for us yesterday at 60% confidence, and now we're circling them again for Saturday's matchup against San Diego. This time, the model's a bit more cautious at 50%, which tells me this one's going to be tight.

Michael King takes the ball for the Padres, and he's been solid down the stretch. Logan Henderson counters for Milwaukee, and American Family Field has been good to the Brewers lately. I've seen enough of these divisional matchups to know that home cooking matters, especially this late in the season.

content.title: ⭐ Tomorrow's Top Pick - October 4
content.value: Milwaukee Brewers over San Diego Padres
content.sub: 50% confidence · King vs Henderson · Home field advantage

content.value:
## The Veteran's Take

A 50% call isn't exactly lighting the world on fire, but that's baseball in October. Everything tightens up. The fact that we liked Milwaukee at 60% yesterday and they delivered, then we're back on them again today? That tells me something about their current form.

I've been around long enough to trust the small edges. Home field, momentum, and a pitcher like Henderson who knows how to work his home crowd—these things add up. We're not swinging for the fences here. We're taking what the game gives us.

See you back here tomorrow to see how it shakes out.

author: Max
